nodes.question: 4. How can methodological choices in LCA-based rating tools impact the assessment of fabrics made from natural fibre types?
nodes.answer: Methodological choices in LCA-based rating tools can impact the assessment of fabrics made from natural fibre types by affecting the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the evaluation, potentially leading to biased results or overlooking specific environmental impacts associated with different fibre types.
